insights.title: High Latency on Report Generation
insights.description: GET /api/reports/jobs/RPT-002-CR showed a p95 latency of 8920ms, indicating a significant delay in report generation.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the report generation process to identify potential optimizations.

insights.title: Slow Document Upload Endpoint
insights.description: POST /api/upload/document had a p95 latency of 5120ms, which may affect user experience during document uploads.
insights.recommendation: Review the upload process for performance improvements.

insights.title: Upload Document Failure
insights.description: POST /api/upload/document returned a 503 error, indicating backend unavailability during the upload process.
insights.recommendation: Monitor the upload service for stability and investigate the cause of the 503 error.

insights.title: Validation Steps in Invoice Submission
insights.description: The sequence for adding a non-PO invoice includes multiple validation steps, which is common in approval workflows.
insights.recommendation: Ensure that validation steps are efficient to streamline the invoice submission process.

executiveSummary: • All tests executed successfully except for two, indicating overall stability.
• High latency observed in report generation, with p95 reaching 8920ms.
• Document upload endpoint experienced a 503 error, impacting user uploads.
• Multiple validation steps were noted in the invoice submission process.
• Performance bottlenecks could affect user experience during critical financial operations.
• Further investigation into the upload service and report generation is recommended.
• Monitoring and optimization efforts may enhance overall system responsiveness.
• Ensuring efficient validation processes will improve invoice handling efficiency.
